The platform's CI on GitHub Actions: checks that the generated files are what the model generates (esquadro gen -check), the playbooks (ansible-lint) and, with cloudflare, the OpenTofu code (tofu validate). It never touches the servers: you apply from your machine. It runs as little as it can, to save Actions minutes: pushes to main and pull requests ready for review, older runs cancelled.

```esquadro
blueprint github_actions
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [server](../server/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [cloudflare](../cloudflare/) when the app uses them.
